set.body: Extract one pure canonical feature-block task from the proven streamed kernel. The task must accept immutable relation blocks plus pairing/query metadata and return bounded total-atom and local-relation contributions. One shared ordered reducer must drive both sequential and future executors. Completion requires exact parity with the current compiler, bounded payload tests, completion-order invariance, and no duplicate scientific path.
set.title: Factor the canonical feature task and ordered reducer
